verdict.rationale: Graphite shows multi-item operations scoped to stacks: a user reports the CLI can rebase multiple branches at once, `gt` can amend staged changes into the relevant commits across a stack, and the stack-aware merge queue lands a series of PRs in order. Graphite Agent can also be set to automatically review all new PRs in selected repositories. This is stack- and repo-scoped batching, not a general bulk-action facility. Missing for 10: documented generic bulk operations across arbitrary PRs or items (e.g., bulk label, close, or approve), bulk actions exposed via the MCP server or an API, and detail on what the 'Automations' feature can do in batch.
